title: Event C1 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is above a threshold)

entities.name: Event C1
entities.description: The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is above a threshold. This event triggers specific UE behavior when the channel utilization exceeds the configured threshold.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that monitors the NR sidelink channel busy ratio and performs actions when Event C1 occurs.

relations.description: Event C1 triggers specific UE behavior when the NR sidelink channel busy ratio exceeds the threshold.
